data.title: 信浓 · 星夜天台的深蓝人鱼礼服
data.description: 港区高层宴会厅外露台上，夜空银河横跨天际。信浓身穿一袭勾勒出绝美曼妙身段的深蓝渐变鱼尾晚礼服，露背设计展现出无暇的雪肌。九条巨大的雪白狐尾在身后如流云般轻拂，金色眸子倒映着漫天璀璨星辰。她转过身来单手轻触胸前蓝宝石项链，出尘的气度宛如从深海与星空中走出的神圣仙姬。
data.action: standing at marble balcony overlooking star-filled ocean, backless navy mermaid evening gown, nine fluffy white tails spread out, golden eyes reflecting stars, ethereal serene smile
data.location: high marble terrace overlooking starry ocean waves
data.lighting: ethereal starlight and soft floor spotlights highlighting glossy navy satin and white fur
data.mood: divine celestial romance, breathtaking otherworldly beauty
data.promptProse: Standing upon a marble terrace beneath a canopy of stars, Shinano wears an elegant deep-blue backless mermaid gown. Her nine fluffy white fox tails drape around her as her golden eyes sparkle with cosmic wonder and love.
data.animaCaption: Shinano in a backless navy mermaid gown with nine white tails under a starlit night sky.
